<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tool_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

uv-mcp exposes **46 tools**. Names mirror the uv CLI, so `uv pip list` is `uv_pip_list`.
Every tool that runs uv returns the same envelope (`success`, `exit_code`, `command`, `cwd`, `stdout`,
`stderr`, `duration_seconds`, `timed_out`, `truncated`, `hint`), plus parsed fields where noted.

Badges reflect the MCP tool annotations clients use to decide when to ask for confirmation:
**read-only** tools never change anything, **destructive** tools can delete or overwrite state or run
arbitrary code, **network** tools may contact package indexes. In read-only mode only read-only tools
are registered.

Rarely used uv flags are not modelled as parameters: pass them through `extra_args`, for example
`extra_args: ["--no-build-isolation"]`. Commands with no dedicated tool are available through `uv_command`.

## Core

Always available, whatever toolsets are enabled.

### `uv_info`

*read-only · idempotent*

Report the uv version, workspace root, enabled toolsets, safety settings and uv's directories.

Call this first if unsure which project the server operates on or whether uv is installed.

No parameters.

### `uv_command`

*destructive · network*

Run an arbitrary uv command. Use only when no dedicated uv_* tool covers what you need.

Not run through a shell. `uv auth token` and `update-shell` commands are refused. In read-only mode
only inspection commands are allowed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `args` | list[string] | **required** | Arguments after `uv`, subcommand first, e.g. ['workspace', 'list'] or ['pip', 'install', '--dry-run', 'x']. Global flags go after the subcommand. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Working directory (default: workspace root). |
| `timeout_seconds` | number |  | Timeout in seconds (default: server setting). |

## Diagnostics

Toolset: `diagnostics`. Understand and fix a project without guessing.

### `uv_project_info`

*read-only · idempotent*

Read pyproject.toml and the project tree: name, version, requires-python, dependencies, groups, extras,
scripts, workspace members, lockfile, .python-version and .venv. Fast; runs no commands.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |

### `uv_diagnose`

*read-only · idempotent · network*

Check that uv works, the project is valid, an interpreter is available, uv.lock is current, .venv exists
and matches the lockfile, and installed packages are consistent. Each finding includes a suggested fix.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |

### `uv_repair`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Fix what uv_diagnose finds: install the required Python, recreate a broken .venv, refresh uv.lock and
sync (reinstalling if packages are inconsistent). Never edits pyproject.toml. Re-diagnoses afterwards.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `dry_run` | bool | `false` | Only return the planned steps without running them. |

## Project

Toolset: `project`. The uv project workflow: `pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock` + `.venv`.

### `uv_init`

*writes*

Create a new uv project (pyproject.toml, .python-version, README, sample code) or a PEP 723 script.

Use this instead of writing pyproject.toml by hand. Follow up with uv_add to add dependencies.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  | Directory to create the project in, or the .py file for kind='script'. Relative to the workspace root; defaults to the workspace root itself. |
| `name` | string |  | Project name (defaults to the directory name). |
| `kind` | `app` \| `lib` \| `script` | `app` | 'app' (default), 'lib' (an installable library) or 'script' (a single PEP 723 script). |
| `package` | bool | `false` | For kind='app': make it an installable package with a build system. |
| `bare` | bool | `false` | Only create pyproject.toml (no README, sample code, .python-version or git). |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `build_backend` | string |  | Build backend for packaged projects, e.g. 'uv', 'hatch', 'setuptools'. |
| `vcs` | `git` \| `none` |  | Version control to initialise (default: git). |
| `no_workspace` | bool | `false` | Do not add the project to an enclosing workspace. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_add`

*writes · network*

Add dependencies to pyproject.toml, update uv.lock and sync the project environment.

This is the right way to install packages for a project; prefer it over uv_pip_install.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list[string] | **required** | Requirement specifiers: names with optional extras/versions ('httpx', 'fastapi[standard]>=0.115'), git URLs ('git+https://github.com/org/repo@v1') or local paths. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `dev` | bool | `false` | Add to the 'dev' dependency group. |
| `group` | string |  | Add to this dependency group (e.g. 'test', 'lint'). |
| `optional` | string |  | Add to this optional-dependency extra. |
| `editable` | bool | `false` | Add local path dependencies as editable. |
| `index` | string |  | Named or URL index to resolve these packages from (--index). |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `no_sync` | bool | `false` | Update pyproject.toml/uv.lock but do not sync the environment (--no-sync). |
| `locked` | bool | `false` | Fail if uv.lock is out of date. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_remove`

*writes · network*

Remove dependencies from pyproject.toml, update uv.lock and sync the environment.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list[string] | **required** | Package names to remove. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `dev` | bool | `false` | Remove from the 'dev' dependency group. |
| `group` | string |  | Remove from this dependency group. |
| `optional` | string |  | Remove from this optional-dependency extra. |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `no_sync` | bool | `false` | Update pyproject.toml/uv.lock but do not sync the environment (--no-sync). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_sync`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Make the project's .venv match uv.lock exactly (creating the venv and lockfile if needed).

Run this after cloning a project, after editing pyproject.toml by hand, or to repair a broken environment.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `extras` | list[string] |  | Optional-dependency extras to include (--extra). |
| `all_extras` | bool | `false` |  |
| `groups` | list[string] |  | Dependency groups to include (--group). |
| `all_groups` | bool | `false` |  |
| `no_dev` | bool | `false` | Exclude the dev group. |
| `upgrade` | bool | `false` | Upgrade all packages to the latest allowed versions. |
| `upgrade_packages` | list[string] |  | Upgrade only these packages. |
| `reinstall` | bool | `false` | Reinstall every package (fixes corrupted installs). |
| `check` | bool | `false` | Only check whether the environment is in sync; change nothing. |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `all_packages` | bool | `false` | Sync every workspace member. |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `frozen` | bool | `false` | Use uv.lock without updating it. |
| `locked` | bool | `false` | Fail if uv.lock is out of date. |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_lock`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Resolve dependencies and write uv.lock without touching the environment.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `upgrade` | bool | `false` | Allow upgrading every package. |
| `upgrade_packages` | list[string] |  | Allow upgrading only these packages. |
| `check` | bool | `false` | Only check whether uv.lock is up to date; write nothing. |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_run`

*destructive · network*

Run a command or script inside the project's environment, syncing it first.

Use this to run tests, scripts, linters and Python one-liners with the project's dependencies.
The command's exit status is returned in exit_code (non-zero is reported as success=false).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | list[string] | **required** | Program and arguments, e.g. ['python', 'main.py'], ['pytest', '-x'], ['python', '-m', 'mymod'] or ['script.py'] for a PEP 723 script. Not run through a shell. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `with_packages` | list[string] |  | Extra packages available only for this run (--with). |
| `env` | object |  | Extra environment variables for the command. |
| `env_file` | string |  | Load environment variables from this .env file. |
| `isolated` | bool | `false` | Run in a temporary environment, leaving .venv untouched. |
| `no_project` | bool | `false` | Ignore the current project (useful for standalone scripts). |
| `no_sync` | bool | `false` | Do not sync the environment before running. |
| `extras` | list[string] |  | Optional-dependency extras to include (--extra). |
| `groups` | list[string] |  | Dependency groups to include (--group). |
| `no_dev` | bool | `false` |  |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `frozen` | bool | `false` | Use uv.lock without updating it. |
| `locked` | bool | `false` | Fail if uv.lock is out of date. |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `timeout_seconds` | number |  | Timeout in seconds (default: server setting). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_tree`

*read-only · idempotent · network*

Display the project's resolved dependency tree from uv.lock. Use invert=true to find why a package is installed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `depth` | int |  | Maximum display depth. |
| `packages` | list[string] |  | Only show the tree rooted at these packages. |
| `invert` | bool | `false` | Show reverse dependencies: who depends on `packages`. |
| `outdated` | bool | `false` | Annotate packages that have newer versions available. |
| `extras` | list[string] |  | Optional-dependency extras to include (--extra). |
| `groups` | list[string] |  | Dependency groups to include (--group). |
| `no_dev` | bool | `false` |  |
| `script` | string |  | PEP 723 script to operate on instead of the project. |
| `frozen` | bool | `false` | Read uv.lock as-is (otherwise a stale lockfile is refreshed). |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_export`

*read-only · idempotent · network*

Export uv.lock as requirements.txt, pylock.toml or a CycloneDX SBOM (e.g. for Docker or other tools).

| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |

| `locked` | bool | `false` | Fail if uv.lock is out of date. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_version`

*writes*

Read the project's version, or set/bump it in pyproject.toml (re-locking and syncing unless told not to).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |

| `dry_run` | bool | `false` | Compute the new version without writing it. |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `no_sync` | bool | `false` | Update pyproject.toml/uv.lock but do not sync the environment (--no-sync). |
| `frozen` | bool | `false` | Use uv.lock without updating it. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

## Python versions

Toolset: `python`. Install, find and pin interpreters.

### `uv_python_list`

*read-only · idempotent · network*

List Python interpreters found on this machine and versions uv can download.

Entries with a null path are downloadable but not installed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | string |  | Only list versions matching this request, e.g. '3.12'. |
| `only_installed` | bool | `false` | Hide versions that are only available for download. |
| `all_versions` | bool | `false` | Include every patch version, not just the latest per minor. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_python_install`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Download and install uv-managed Python versions. With no versions, installs the version the project requires (or the latest).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `versions` | list[string] |  | Version requests such as '3.13', '3.12.4', 'pypy@3.10', '3.14t' (free-threaded). |
| `default` | bool | `false` | Also install `python`/`python3` executables on PATH for this version. |
| `reinstall` | bool | `false` |  |
| `upgrade` | bool | `false` | Upgrade existing installs to the latest patch release. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_python_upgrade`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Upgrade uv-managed Python installs to their latest patch release (all of them if no versions are given).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `versions` | list[string] |  | Version requests such as '3.13', '3.12.4', 'pypy@3.10', '3.14t' (free-threaded). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_python_uninstall`

*destructive · idempotent*

Remove uv-managed Python installations. Virtual environments built on them will stop working.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `versions` | list[string] |  | Version requests such as '3.13', '3.12.4', 'pypy@3.10', '3.14t' (free-threaded). |
| `all` | bool | `false` | Uninstall every uv-managed Python version. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_python_find`

*read-only · idempotent*

Return the path of the interpreter uv would use (honouring .python-version, requires-python and .venv).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | string |  | Version request, e.g. '3.12'. Defaults to the project's requirement. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `system` | bool | `false` | Ignore virtual environments and only consider system interpreters. |
| `script` | string |  | Find the interpreter for this PEP 723 script. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_python_pin`

*writes · idempotent*

Read or write .python-version, which selects the interpreter uv uses for the project.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | string |  | Version to pin, e.g. '3.12'. Omit to show the current pin. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `global_pin` | bool | `false` | Write the user-level default pin (uv --global) instead of the project's. |
| `resolved` | bool | `false` | Pin the full interpreter version/path instead of the request as typed. |
| `remove` | bool | `false` | Delete the .python-version pin. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

## pip interface

Toolset: `pip`. Environment-level package management for plain virtualenvs and requirements files.

### `uv_pip_install`

*writes · network*

Install packages into a virtual environment without recording them in pyproject.toml.

For uv projects use uv_add instead so the dependency is declared and locked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list[string] |  | Requirement specifiers to install. |
| `requirements` | list[string] |  | Requirement files (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, pylock.toml), relative to project_path. |
| `editable` | list[string] |  | Local paths to install in editable mode (-e). |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `python` | string |  | Target environment: venv path, python path or version (default: .venv in project_path or a parent). |
| `system` | bool | `false` | Target the system Python. Avoid unless the user asked for it. |
| `break_system_packages` | bool | `false` | Allow modifying an externally-managed (PEP 668) Python. |
| `target` | string |  | Install into this directory instead of an environment (--target). |
| `upgrade` | bool | `false` |  |
| `reinstall` | bool | `false` |  |
| `dry_run` | bool | `false` |  |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_pip_uninstall`

*destructive · idempotent*

Remove packages from a virtual environment (does not edit pyproject.toml; use uv_remove for projects).

| `system` | bool | `false` | Target the system Python. Avoid unless the user asked for it. |
| `dry_run` | bool | `false` |  |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_pip_check`

*read-only · idempotent*

|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `python` | string |  | Target environment: venv path, python path or version (default: .venv in project_path or a parent). |
| `system` | bool | `false` | Target the system Python. Avoid unless the user asked for it. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_pip_compile`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Resolve loose requirements into a fully pinned requirements.txt or pylock.toml.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src_files` | list[string] | **required** | Input files: requirements.in, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg... (relative to project_path). |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `output_file` | string |  | Write the pinned result here. Omit to return it in stdout. |
| `format` | `requirements.txt` \| `pylock.toml` |  |  |
| `universal` | bool | `false` | Produce a platform-independent resolution. |
| `generate_hashes` | bool | `false` |  |
| `upgrade` | bool | `false` |  |
| `extras` | list[string] |  | Extras to include (pyproject.toml inputs). |
| `python_version` | string |  | Resolve for this Python version, e.g. '3.11'. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_pip_sync`

*destructive · idempotent · network*

Make an environment contain exactly the listed packages, uninstalling everything else.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src_files` | list[string] | **required** | Pinned requirements.txt or pylock.toml files. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `python` | string |  | Target environment: venv path, python path or version (default: .venv in project_path or a parent). |
| `system` | bool | `false` | Target the system Python. Avoid unless the user asked for it. |
| `dry_run` | bool | `false` |  |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

## Virtual environments

Toolset: `venv`.

### `uv_venv`

*writes · network*

Create a virtual environment. For uv projects, uv_sync creates and fills .venv automatically.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `path` | string |  | Environment directory, relative to project_path (default: .venv). |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `seed` | bool | `false` | Install pip (and setuptools/wheel on old Pythons) into the venv. |
| `clear` | bool | `false` | Replace an existing environment at this path. |
| `prompt` | string |  | Prompt prefix shown when the venv is activated. |
| `system_site_packages` | bool | `false` |  |
| `relocatable` | bool | `false` |  |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

## Tools (uvx)

Toolset: `tool`. Run or install Python command-line tools in isolated environments.

### `uv_tool_run`

*destructive · network*

Run a Python command-line tool in a cached, ephemeral environment (what `uvx` does).

Ideal for one-off linters, formatters and generators without adding them to the project.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | list[string] | **required** | Tool executable and arguments, e.g. ['ruff', 'check', '.'] or ['pycowsay', 'hi']. |
| `from_package` | string |  | Package providing the executable when names differ or to pin a version, e.g. 'httpie', 'ruff==0.6.0'. |
| `with_packages` | list[string] |  | Extra packages to install alongside the tool. |
| `project_path` | string |  | Working directory for the tool (default: workspace root). |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `isolated` | bool | `false` | Ignore any installed version of the tool. |
| `env` | object |  | Extra environment variables. |
| `timeout_seconds` | number |  | Timeout in seconds (default: server setting). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_tool_install`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Install a Python CLI tool into its own isolated environment and put its executables on PATH (user-wide).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `package` | string | **required** | Package to install, optionally with a version or URL, e.g. 'ruff', 'black==24.1.0'. |
| `with_packages` | list[string] |  | Extra packages to include in the tool's environment. |
| `editable` | bool | `false` |  |
| `force` | bool | `false` | Overwrite executables that already exist on PATH. |
| `upgrade` | bool | `false` |  |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_tool_upgrade`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Upgrade installed tools to the latest versions their constraints allow.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list[string] |  | Tools to upgrade. |
| `all` | bool | `false` | Upgrade every installed tool. |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_tool_uninstall`

*destructive · idempotent*

Remove installed tools and their executables.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list[string] |  | Tools to uninstall. |
| `all` | bool | `false` | Uninstall every tool. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_tool_list`

*read-only · idempotent*

List tools installed with uv tool install, their versions and executables.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outdated` | bool | `false` | Only show tools with newer versions available (queries the index). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

## Packaging

Toolset: `build`. Build and publish distributions.

### `uv_build`

*writes · idempotent · network*

Build the project into distributable archives. Both sdist and wheel are built unless one is selected.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `out_dir` | string |  | Output directory, relative to project_path (default: dist/). |
| `sdist` | bool | `false` | Build only a source distribution. |
| `wheel` | bool | `false` | Build only a wheel. |
| `member` | string |  | Workspace member (--package). |
| `all_packages` | bool | `false` | Build every workspace member. |
| `clear` | bool | `false` | Empty the output directory first. |
| `python` | string |  | Python to use: version ('3.12'), 'pypy@3.10' or a path. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_publish`

*destructive · network*

Upload built distributions to PyPI or another index. Irreversible: a version can never be re-uploaded.

Runs as a dry run unless dry_run=false is passed explicitly. Credentials are passed to uv
through environment variables, never on the command line, and are redacted from output.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_path` | string |  | Project directory, absolute or relative to the workspace root (default: workspace root). |
| `files` | list[string] |  | Files or globs to upload (default: dist/*). |
| `dry_run` | bool | `true` | Validate without uploading. Defaults to true: set false only when the user asked to publish. |
| `index` | string |  | Name of an index from [[tool.uv.index]] to publish to. |
| `publish_url` | string |  | Upload endpoint, e.g. https://test.pypi.org/legacy/. |
| `check_url` | string |  | Index URL used to skip files that are already uploaded. |
| `trusted_publishing` | `automatic` \| `always` \| `never` |  |  |
| `token` | string |  | API token. Prefer trusted publishing or UV_PUBLISH_TOKEN in the server env; never echoed back. |
| `username` | string |  |  |
| `password` | string |  | Password (never echoed back). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

## Cache

Toolset: `cache`.

### `uv_cache_clean`

*destructive · idempotent*

Delete cached downloads and builds. Fixes corrupted-cache errors; later installs will re-download.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list[string] |  | Only remove entries for these packages (default: everything). |
| `force` | bool | `false` | Remove even if another uv process holds the cache lock. |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_cache_prune`

*writes · idempotent*

Remove unused and stale cache entries to reclaim disk space without losing what is in use.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ci` | bool | `false` | Also drop pre-built wheels, keeping only what is expensive to rebuild (for CI caches). |
| `extra_args` | list[string] |  | Extra raw uv flags, e.g. ['--offline']. |

### `uv_cache_size`

*read-only · idempotent*

Report how much disk space the uv cache uses.

No parameters.

## Authentication

Toolset: `auth`. Credentials for private package indexes.

### `uv_auth_login`

*writes · idempotent*

Save credentials for a package index in uv's credential store so later installs can authenticate.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | string | **required** | Index domain or URL, e.g. 'pypi.example.com' or 'https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/org/'. |
| `token` | string |  | Access token (sent to uv over stdin, never echoed back). |
| `username` | string |  |  |
| `password` | string |  | Password (sent over stdin, never echoed back). |

### `uv_auth_logout`

*destructive · idempotent*

Delete stored credentials for a package index.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | string | **required** | Index domain or URL, e.g. 'pypi.example.com' or 'https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/org/'. |
| `username` | string |  |  |
